tasks.subject: Task 3: Anchor-based contradiction detection
tasks.description:

- Test: `engine/tests/test_case_contradiction.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] A pair is returned when the two anchors share `time_ordinal` and differ on `location_ref`

tasks.subject: Task 12: ORM models for the six case tables
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add six SQLAlchemy models matching the approved design, in house style. Two gotchas: engine/db/orm.py imports `text` from SQLAlchemy so a column attribute named `text` shadows it — name it `body_text` and declare it after all server_default=text(...) columns; and BigInteger must be added to the import block at orm.py:3-6 for `seed`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `engine/db/orm.py`
- Test: `engine/tests/test_case_orm.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Six models: `Case`, `CaseAnchorRow`, `CaseCastRow`, `CaseEvidenceRow`, `CaseFactRow`, `CaseFalsehoodRow` — the `Row` suffix avoids colliding with the Pydantic `CaseAnchor`
- [ ] Every PK is `PGUUID(as_uuid=True)` with `server_default=text("gen_random_uuid()")`, matching all 22 existing tables
- [ ] `Case.session_id` is a non-nullable FK to `sessions.session_id` with `UniqueConstraint("session_id")`
- [ ] The three anchor FKs are nullable
- [ ] The `EvidenceEntry.text` column is named `body_text` and mapped explicitly
- [ ] `Base.metadata.create_all` succeeds on SQLite after `patch_metadata_for_sqlite()`

**Verify:** `python -m pytest engine/tests/test_case_orm.py -v` → all pass
